records.title: A complete negatively curved observation Gramian with two-state ambiguity
records.description:
We give a nonvacuous two-dimensional counterexample to the manifold conjecture printed by Krener in OWR11/2009. A smooth observed system on a connected closed genus-three surface has zero dynamics and output in R17 obtained by composing a connected two-sheeted hyperbolic covering with a smooth Nash isometric embedding. Its exact finite-time differential observation Gramian is P_T=T*pi^*g. For every fixed positive T it is geodesically complete with actual sectional curvature -1/T and uniform positive upper and lower bounds relative to any fixed smooth background metric and a fixed finite normalized atlas. The history map is locally injective but every attained history has exactly two initial states.

The construction is an application of classical constructions, with Nash, covering classification, hyperbolic geometry and older local/global observability ambiguity explicitly credited. A bounded primary-source audit, including complete readings of Dirr2009 and Kang2013 and a fresh independent adversarial priority assessment, found no verified earlier explicit complete construction in inspected sources. Those two named access gaps are closed; older uninspected originals and corpus limits are documented. No absolute firstness, continuous seventeen-year openness, new covering/Nash mechanism, or first refutation of every literal dimensional reading is claimed. A strengthened question restricted to one global Euclidean state domain is outside this result.

AI tools were used extensively in solving, drafting, reproducing and adversarially reviewing the work. This is an unrefereed preprint without conventional human peer review. The package provides the analytical proof and a dependency-free supplementary exact verifier with recorded results, source and priority supplement, reproducibility instructions, license and file digests. Finite controls do not construct a Nash embedding or machine-certify global topology or completeness.

records.title: A flow reduction for equilibrium uniqueness in rank-one bimatrix games
records.description: For explicitly listed rational bimatrix games of variable positive dimensions and exact rank(A+B)=1, uniqueness of the entire mixed-strategy equilibrium pair is coNP-complete and NONUNIQUENESS is NP-complete, allowing arbitrary degeneracy. A polynomial reduction from nonempty positive-integer PARTITION produces a known strict pure equilibrium and an additional pair exactly in yes instances. The proof applies the Disser–Skutella signed flow counter and the Adsul/coauthors auxiliary zero-sum representation, with a tailored comparison-preserving perturbation, injective simplex encoding and uniform all-minimizer exact penalty. The support package preserves authored original and fresh review evidence. A bounded primary-source audit found no exact match among inspected bodies; worldwide priority remains unknown.
